sloka: उवाच लक्ष्मणम् रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता ।कृच्छ्रात् कृच्छ्रतरम् प्राप्य दारुणम् सत्य विक्रम ॥३-६९-४७॥
transliteration: uvāca lakṣmaṇam rāmo mukhena pariśuṣyatā ।kṛcchrāt kṛcchrataram prāpya dāruṇam satya vikrama ॥3-69-47॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, your valour is truth.We have gone through from one calamity to a greater one without finding the beloved Sita. Now we have landed into a terrible crisis which will put an end to our own life.
